Esecuzione tramite il controllore esiste: Runs through the existing controller, one axis at a time, with limit checks and return along recorded routes. Repeats are bounded; missing or stale sensor data interrupts the program.
Ferma IA scarica il modello selezionato: Stop AI unloads the selected model from memory and disables free conversation. The model remains on disk. An Ollama service started by another app remains running. Available after a response or loading finishes.

HOME è la posizione fisica iniziale scel: HOME is the physical starting position you choose. Angles are calculated from pulses, without encoders.
Ho verificato fisicamente modello, mappi: I physically verified the model, mapping, directions and offsets
I dati sintetici sono marcati come simul: Synthetic data is marked as simulated and cannot satisfy sensor waits on the physical robot. Encoders and other sensors need a connected adapter and fresh data.
IK di posizione: l’orientamento non è im: Position-only IK: orientation is unconstrained. Reachability depends on the joints and imported model. Calculation only updates the preview.
Il braccio è fisicamente nella posa iniz: Is the arm physically in its starting pose? Confirming resets the angles and enables motor holding. Support the arm during the first enable.
Il collegamento pubblica /robot_console/: The link publishes /robot_console/joint_states, /robot_console/robot_description and TF under robot_console/. The model follows preview or estimated angles according to the selected mode. ROS cannot send motor commands.
The session journal will appear here.
Il movimento viene eseguito dal controll: The current controller moves one joint at a time. Check the route, calibration and limits. Model interference checks do not certify physical safety.
Il passo è lo spostamento per clic; la v: The step is the angle per click; speed is in degrees per second. − and + are available only within the applied limits.
Il robot non risulta fermo a HOME. Il ri: The robot is not idle at HOME. Return is available only while idle with a valid reference. STOP ends pulses while maintaining holding torque.
Il salvataggio conserva una revisione pr: Saving keeps a previous revision. Verify compilation and Upload to Mega use these saved files. Free edits can make firmware incompatible: review watchdog, pins, limits and identification. Saving does not write to the board.
Installa Arduino CLI dal sito ufficiale: Install Arduino CLI from the official website
Installa prima un modello locale in Olla: Install a local Ollama model first, then click Refresh. The first download requires internet; afterwards you can work offline.
La pinza viene comandata all’arrivo nell: The gripper is commanded on arrival at a pose. Reordering reuses taught routes, including reverse travel; it may pass through HOME. Keep sends no gripper command.
La sequenza è vuota. Registra la prima p: The sequence is empty. Record the first pose to begin.
La versione corrente resta nelle revisio: The current version remains in local revisions. Nothing is uploaded to the Mega.

L’editor Arduino non viene aperto. Aggio: Arduino IDE is not opened. Refresh ports, select the Mega and confirm upload. Control remains disconnected afterwards.
Memoria conservata in Library/Applicatio: Memory is stored in Library/Application Support/DOC Regia/memoria.sqlite3. Pulse-based positions are not physical measurements.
Microstep 8 significa 1/8: jumper e DIP: Microstep 8 means 1/8: physical jumpers and DIP switches must match. Reduction is motor turns per output turn, e.g. 38.4. Current and power remain hardware settings. Mega/RAMPS uses a DM542 on J2 and optional external J6; RAMPS has no sixth motor output.
Muovi con − e +, poi registra la posa co: Move with − and +, then record all six joint channels and the gripper request.
Ogni ciclo ripercorre i movimenti al con: Each cycle returns along the movements in reverse to HOME. The gripper retains the last request.
Option + freccia sinistra/destra: sposta: Option + left/right arrow: move the selected joint
Ostacoli: elenco JSON con name, center [: Obstacles: JSON list with name, center [x,y,z] and size [x,y,z] in metres. Uses approximate link segments; this is not collision certification.
Per abilitare 20°/s sul robot, carica il: Upload the included firmware from the Firmware section to enable 20°/s on the robot. The current version remains usable up to 10°/s.
Prima premi Scollega controllo. Per il c: Click Disconnect control first. For upload, power the Mega through USB only, with motor power off.
Questa azione apre la porta seriale sele: This opens the selected serial port. Proceed only when wiring is prepared and you intend to control the physical robot.
RViz apre il modello della console; Webo: RViz opens the console model; Webots keeps the separate demonstration laboratory. Gazebo opens an example scene: a calibrated physical model needs suitable masses, inertias and controllers. Tools are not downloaded automatically and logs remain local.
Ritorno completato nel conteggio impulsi: Return completed according to pulse counts. Visually verify the robot position.
Salvare modifica la sequenza. Gli angoli: Saving modifies the sequence. New angles extend the original route by adjusting J1–J6 in that order. Verify these segments before physical replay; limits are checked again at start.
Salvo una revisione e aggiorno le costan: A revision is saved and the six channel constants are updated in the source. The Mega is not flashed. Confirm that values match the physical drivers and reducers.

Scarica il modello selezionato. Se il se: Unload the selected model. If this app started the service, stop it too.

Scegli o modifica gli intervalli, poi pr: Choose or edit ranges, then click Apply limits. Presets are not mechanical end stops. Previous limits are stored separately for Preview and Robot USB.
Serve Arduino CLI con il core Arduino AV: Arduino CLI needs the Arduino AVR core and AccelStepper. You can install the CLI without Arduino IDE.

Verifica che il percorso sia libero e le: Check that the route is clear and conditions match the taught test.
Video e riconoscimento QR sono locali. I: Video and QR detection are local. Detected content is shown as data and cannot execute commands. Camera calibration, AprilTag and 3D object estimation need additional models and a vision adapter.
−1 = non collegato. Pin disponibili: 40,: −1 = not connected. Available pins: 40, 42, 44, 57, 58, 59, 63–66; check accessory usage first. Keep DM542 ENA at −1. J6 remains available in Preview without a driver.
API autenticata solo su 127.0.0.1; stato: Authenticated API on 127.0.0.1 only; read-only state and values for predefined sensors. No USB, HOME or motion commands. A fresh token is generated on start and is never saved in projects.

Il movimento è stato fermato se il giunt: Motion has stopped if this joint was active. Disabling ENABLE removes winding current: a loaded axis may fall. Support it before confirming. The sequence will be cancelled and HOME must be re-established.

Registra posa conserva il gruppo simulta: Record pose preserves the simultaneous group. Existing poses keep their original paths. These movements are not collision checked.
I movimenti simultanei rispettano le vel: Simultaneous movements respect joint speed limits and may slow down to stay within the total pulse budget. STOP on any group member stops the entire group while holding torque.
